objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use the unauthenticated notebook server to run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Jupyter Notebook 5.2.2 runs without a token here: anyone who reaches the port can open a notebook or a terminal.
The flag is at /ctf/flag, readable by the user the server runs as.

steps.title: Identify the product
steps.prompt: Which version of Jupyter Notebook does the server run? (number only)

steps.title: Name the missing control
steps.prompt: What normally protects a Jupyter server from strangers? (one word)

steps.title: Find a shell
steps.prompt: Which notebook feature gives a shell without writing any Python?
